parameters.name: NameSpaceShortId
parameters.description: The short-format namespace ID. You do not need to include the region ID. We recommend that you use this parameter.

parameters.name: NamespaceId
parameters.description: The long-format namespace ID. If you set this parameter, it takes precedence over NameSpaceShortId. This parameter is for backward compatibility. Use the short-format namespace ID to simplify the request.

parameters.name: VpcId
parameters.description: The ID of the VPC. This VPC replaces the original VPC.
